rules.title: AWS access key ID in source
rules.message: Hard-coded AWS access key ID. Rotate the key and move credentials to a secret store or environment injected at runtime.
rules.fix: Remove the key from source, rotate in IAM, load via env/secret manager.

rules.title: Likely hard-coded API key or secret
rules.message: Assignment looks like a live secret in source. Prefer environment variables or a vault.
rules.fix: Replace with process env / secret manager references; rotate the exposed value.

rules.title: PEM private key material
rules.message: Private key material committed to the tree.
rules.fix: Remove the key, rotate, store outside the repo.
